name: Original Group Header 21
definition: Provides details on the original group, to which the message refers.

GroupCancellationIdentification.name: Group Cancellation Identification
GroupCancellationIdentification.definition: Unique identification, as assigned by the assigner, to unambiguously identify the group cancellation request.||Usage: The group cancellation request identification can be used for reconciliation or to link tasks related to the cancellation request.

Case.name: Case
Case.definition: Uniquely and unambiguously identifies an exception or an investigation workflow.

OriginalMessageIdentification.name: Original Message Identification
OriginalMessageIdentification.definition: Point to point reference, as assigned by the original instructing party, to unambiguously identify the original message.

OriginalMessageNameIdentification.name: Original Message Name Identification
OriginalMessageNameIdentification.definition: Specifies the original message name identifier to which the message refers.

OriginalCreationDateTime.name: Original Creation Date Time
OriginalCreationDateTime.definition: Date and time at which the original message was created.

NumberOfTransactions.name: Number Of Transactions
NumberOfTransactions.definition: Number of individual transactions contained in the original message.

ControlSum.name: Control Sum
ControlSum.definition: Total of all individual amounts included in the message, irrespective of currencies.

GroupCancellation.name: Group Cancellation
GroupCancellation.definition: Indicates whether the cancellation request applies to a whole group of transactions or to individual transactions within an original group.

CancellationReasonInformation.name: Cancellation Reason Information
CancellationReasonInformation.definition: Provides detailed information on the cancellation reason.

GroupCancellationAndReasonRule.definition: If GroupCancellation is true, then CancellationReasonInformation/Reason must present.
